title: Topic: paracetamol side effects
description:
13. Headache & Flushing 🥵

Don't panic if your face gets red or your head thumps a bit.

Since these meds widen your blood vessels (vasodilation), it happens everywhere—including your face and brain. It’s a common side effect, but if it’s painful, talk to your pro.
